rewrite:
def get_safety_version() ->str:
    from safety import __version__
    return __version__


def build_telemetry_data(telemetry: bool=True, command: Optional[str]=None,
    subcommand: Optional[str]=None) ->TelemetryModel:
    from safety import __version__
    from safety.util import build_git_data
    telemetry_data = {
        "version": __version__,
        "telemetry": telemetry,
        "command": command,
        "subcommand": subcommand,
        "platform": platform.platform(),
        "python_version": platform.python_version(),
        "git": build_git_data()
    }
    return TelemetryModel(**telemetry_data)
